timeline.text: The hallway screen showed a bare calendar — vague labels, homework cut off mid-word, cancelled lessons showing as if nothing changed.
Nobody could tell at a glance which child had gym or swimming that day.
Now a lookup table color-codes each subject, hides cancelled lessons, and gives every event its real title.
Gym and swimming days get their own icon from each child's timetable.
Every pupil's whole week now rotates across the screen at once — no more guessing at vague labels.
